name: DEKOIS 2.0
description: A public library of challenging docking benchmark sets designed to evaluate and optimize virtual screening and molecular docking workflows.
evaluation_method: ROC-AUC (commonly reported alongside enrichment factor (EF) and BEDROC)
reputation: Widely used in computational chemistry and virtual screening research as a challenging decoy-based docking benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark for molecular docking/virtual screening; contains designed decoys that can introduce dataset bias; per-target sizes vary so evaluation is often reported per-target rather than pooled.
